pages.text: The five played in the lodge. A sharp wooden splinter stuck in Soso's foot.
Soso said nothing, afraid they would have to stop playing.
They played tag. Soso kept getting caught.
The foot hurt more and more. Soso sat in a corner.
The four kept running around. Soso couldn't get up.
The foot was red and swollen. Soso held it in both hands.
Grandma Bear examined Soso's foot. "Tell us when it hurts, so it can get better."
Grandma pulled out the splinter. Soso's eyes widened.
The five ran around again. Soso was the fastest.
